set.text: Revision and punctuation diagnostics. The isolated raised É/E is not expanded to Évitons, and the slanted word structure is transcribed only in the margin where it is written. The two Y variables visibly overwrite earlier Z forms; both layers are preserved. The heavy initial cylindrique group does not yield an independently readable additional cancelled word. Both main homéom forms have no stop, but the marginal homéom. has a real dot. The source writes cônique twice. Root audit identifies the isolated irregular blot below faux as lacking a recoverable linguistic or geometric structure; the draft graphic is removed and its crop remains available. The final le sont, with sont now explicitly uncertain, reaches the paper edge without a recoverable following full stop. A curved insertion leader at (absolu) and one at en général are attachment strokes, not extra parentheses/underlines. These are source-state decisions, not mathematical emendations.
